6169.title: Account-pool threshold excludes upstream-allowed capacity
6169.rootCauseOneLine: Routing and retry availability treat switchThreshold as exhaustion even when the upstream window remains allowed; only extra usage bypasses the cutoff.
6169.proposedFix: Decide whether the documented hard cutoff becomes a soft routing preference, then share the chosen eligibility rule across selection, availability, and account status while preserving real rejections and holds.
6169.caveats: Synthetic provider responses reproduce the real plugin routing boundary in two clean checkouts; the reporter's live accounts and retry timeline were not accessed. No PR: changing documented threshold/reserve semantics requires a product decision. The complete reproduction patch and output are inline in the report.
